piezas.titular: Fil i compte lets teachers prepare printable maths problem sheets in Catalan and Spanish, with an answer key
piezas.entradilla: A bank of 252 problems lets primary and lower secondary teachers pick problems, put them in order and print the worksheet or save it as a PDF.
cuerpo: “Fil i compte” is a web tool created by Aarón Fortuño and published under the MIT licence. According to the page, it brings together 252 maths problems, in Catalan and in Spanish, designed for the middle and upper cycles of primary school and for the start of lower secondary. The resource opens in the browser, and the page asks for no registration or account.

Teachers can filter the bank by approximate level, by difficulty (accessible, intermediate or challenging) and by content: addition and subtraction, multiplication and division, combined operations, brackets, fractions, percentages, decimals, powers, roots, direct and inverse proportion or estimation. Each topic can be marked as allowed, required or excluded. There is also a reasoning category and a “distractor data” one, with problems that include information that is not needed to solve them. Those who would rather not choose can ask for an automatic worksheet suggestion, and it is possible to search by text or by each problem’s code.

Each problem is displayed with its code, level, difficulty and content tags; for example, the one about the apples in the school vegetable garden is middle-cycle and low difficulty. Once the problems have been chosen, they are put in order and the number of pages (1, 2, 4 or 6) and of problems per page is set. The type of working space is also chosen: dotted, squared or lined. The worksheet is printed and, according to the repository’s listing, it can also be saved as a PDF. The page lets users switch between the exercises and the answer key, which is printed separately. Templates can be saved in the browser, so teachers can reuse a selection on that same computer.

In class, it can be used to quickly prepare practice sheets adapted to different groups or difficulty levels within the same classroom, or for revision tasks with the solutions to hand. The problems, the answer key and the interface are in Catalan and in Spanish. The code is published on GitHub, and the page states that it uses visit analytics without personal data, which can be switched off.

piezas.comprobado: Se miró la captura (banco de problemas con filtros, tarjetas P0001 a P0009 en catalán, selección de problemas, botón de imprimir, selector de idioma, plantillas) y se leyó el texto visible de la página. WebFetch de la web confirmó solucionario alternable con los ejercicios, impresión (sin mención de PDF, que consta solo en la ficha), plantillas guardadas en el navegador, idiomas catalán y castellano, sin cuenta y analítica desactivable. El repositorio de GitHub confirma la licencia MIT y el castellano. No se comprobó el PDF ni el solucionario generado. Sin publicaciones previas relacionadas en publicado.txt.

repaso: Número de páginas: «de una a seis» pasa a «1, 2, 4 o 6», como ofrece la página.
PDF: se mantiene como dicho por la ficha, porque la página solo habla de imprimir.
Solucionario: confirmado en la página (alterna ejercicios y solucionario, que se imprime aparte); se quita «según la ficha» y se describe.
Idioma: confirmado en la página que ofrece castellano; se quita la atribución a la ficha.
Plantillas: se precisa que quedan en el navegador donde se guardan.
